_comment: The new-career intro (AW-234). The game reads this for captions and timing; tools/audio/narrate.py reads it to render the voiceover (public/assets/intro/vo-<n>.ogg). "say" is how the narrator should pronounce a line when it differs from the caption. Motion: start and end transforms of the panel (scale, x and y offsets in % of the frame).

scenes.text: In the mid-21st century, mankind was surpassed by AI in all respects, triggering an existential crisis.
scenes.say: In the mid twenty-first century, mankind was surpassed by AI in all respects, triggering an existential crisis.

scenes.text: Some chose to seek their fortunes in the stars. One ship, the Intrepid, departed with two million souls bound for Kepler-186.
scenes.say: Some chose to seek their fortunes in the stars. One ship, the Intrepid, departed with two million souls bound for Kepler one eight six.

scenes.text: The journey was long, and colonists slept in stasis while dreaming of a better tomorrow.
But on the way, something went horribly wrong. The ship encountered an anomaly, triggering an early awakening.
We woke among stars no one had ever charted and started the calendar again: After Waking.
Thirty years on, the Intrepid is a city adrift. Its reactors are failing, its decks are crowded, and its people are divided.
But the stars beckon the bold. After years of saving, you've staked everything on a run-down freighter. Find your fortune out there, and maybe find us a home.
